MP Govt Relaxes Promotion Criteria for Thousands of Employees

The Madhya Pradesh government has cleared the path for promotions for thousands of state government employees. A decision has been made to grant promotions even to those who have not passed the Computer Proficiency Certification Test (CPCT). This relief is particularly for fourth-grade employees who have completed 45 years of age. The General Administration Department (GAD) has issued instructions regarding this relaxation.
